## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

List commands run and their outcomes. Note skipped checks or unverified behavior.

## Screenshots

For visible UI changes, include screenshots when useful. Otherwise, write N/A.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and documentation reflects behavior changes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Menu changes include regenerated `menu-file.js`, if applicable.
- [ ] Canvas assets are allowlisted in `hosting.mjs`, if applicable.
- [ ] Timing and animation changes preserve pausing and reduced-motion behavior.
